_why: Every printed total on pages 2 and 3, with the printed operands that feed it, so gate step 11 can recompute each one from what the PAGE draws rather than from what the record says. Authored from the printed captions, quoted verbatim.
authored_from: THE PRINTED PAGE, read with adapters/pdf/page-geometry.mjs. Every `caption` below is drawn text quoted verbatim; every operand list is the one the caption itself names.
_slice: SLICE 2 - the nineteen markers on pages 2 and 3. Pages 4, 5 and 6 print lines (5) through (20) and Boxes A through H and are NOT declared here; step 11 checks what this file declares and reports the rest as unauthored, which is what a partial slice should read as.
_notes: THE FLOOR IS PRINTED AND IT IS PRINTED ONCE. "Round to the nearest dollar. Do not enter a negative number. If any line item is a negative number, enter \"0\"." is drawn at y 670.9 x 165.2..576.0 on page 2, above the first total on the form. It is quoted as floor_caption on all four Add-lines totals rather than on the first only, because a floor declared on one line and not its siblings would read as a difference between the lines that the page does not draw.

THE MULTIPLIER IS 0.8 AND IT IS READ OFF THE PAGE. "X .8 = $" is drawn six times on page 3 - twice in the real-estate block at x 125.9..155.9 and four times in the vehicle block at x 115.1..145.1 (three rows plus the (4d) attachment caption). The leaf name is Times_8 and it agrees, which is recorded as agreement and not relied on: 433-A(OIC) carries a cell named Times_7 that the page multiplies by .8, and that is registry entry C02 and the reason this declaration reads the factor off the drawn text.

THE INVESTMENT ROWS CARRY NO MULTIPLIER. The (2a) and (2b) rows print "– $" between the value cell and the loan cell and nothing else. Declared with no factor. The real-estate and vehicle rows print "X .8 = $" and a third money cell for the result. Two shapes that look alike at a glance and are not.

THE VEHICLE TOTAL IS ONE PRINTED CELL WITH TWO DEFINED VALUES. "Total value of vehicle (if the vehicle is leased, enter 0 as the total value)" names a selector that is a printed box on the same row - the Lease/Own pair. Each of the three rows is declared as TWO predicated lines, so exactly one is checked on any filled form and the other is SKIPPED with its reason printed. Declaring only the OWN branch would leave the printed 0 on a leased row unverified while the transcript read clean.

Declared rather than left out: a cell absent from both lists is indistinguishable from one nobody looked at. Mirrors 433boi.map.json._not_checkable. entries.why_not_checkable: Everything it sums is on an attachment and not on this form, so nothing printed on the page could verify it. It is nevertheless an operand of (1), which IS checkable.
entries.review_page_advisory: Line (1d) is a total of bank accounts listed on an attachment. Nothing on this form verifies it; check it against the attachment before filing.

entries.printed_caption: Total investment accounts from attachment. [current market value minus loan balance(s)]
entries.why_not_checkable: Same shape as (1d). The bracketed part of the caption states arithmetic the preparer does on the attachment, not arithmetic this form prints operands for.
entries.review_page_advisory: Line (2d) is a total from an attachment, already net of loan balances. Nothing on this form verifies it.

entries.why_not_checkable: Same shape as (1d), and the bracketed instruction repeats the X .8 discount for rows that are not on this page.
entries.review_page_advisory: Line (3c) must already have the X .8 quick-sale discount applied to the attached properties. This form applies it only to the two rows it prints.

entries.why_not_checkable: NOT A TOTAL AT ALL AND DECLARED HERE ANYWAY. It is a money-shaped cell on pages this slice authors that no line adds up and no line adds it into - the only such cell on either page. Listing it makes "no total checks this" a stated fact rather than an absence; leaving it out would put it in neither list, which is the state this block exists to prevent.
entries.review_page_advisory: The listing price is what the property is currently offered at, not its market value. It feeds no total on this form.
